provenance.paper_title: Embodied Agents Meet Personalization: Investigating Challenges and Solutions Through the Lens of Memory Utilization

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Past interactions become personalized object and routine memory entries. agents retrieve object-semantic and user-pattern memories for planning.
During operation, MEMENTO Personalization applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to object/user-pattern memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.
During operation, MEMENTO Personalization applies episodic or hierarchical summarization to object/user-pattern memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 3): During inference, the operative memory component (object/user-pattern memory) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, episodic or hierarchical summarization; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
